listPage.heading: Server parameters
listPage.description: All server configuration parameters stored in the database.

descriptions.MAIL_HOST: SMTP server host used to send all transactional e-mails (licences, orders, expiry reminders). If empty, e-mail sending is disabled.
descriptions.MAIL_PORT: SMTP server port (e.g. 587 for a STARTTLS connection).
descriptions.MAIL_USER: Username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.
descriptions.MAIL_PASS: Password used to authenticate with the SMTP server (write-only, never displayed).
descriptions.MAIL_FROM: Sender e-mail address shown in the "From" field of every outgoing transactional e-mail.
descriptions.MAIL_SENDER_NAME: Sender display name shown next to the "From" address in outgoing e-mails.
descriptions.MAIL_SMTP_STARTTLS: Whether the SMTP connection uses STARTTLS encryption ("true" / "false").
descriptions.MAIL_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS: Comma-separated list of days before expiration when a licence expiry reminder e-mail is sent (e.g. "30,7").
descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_OPEN_RPM: Maximum requests per minute per IP address allowed on public, no-auth endpoints (shop, licence lookup).
